metas.name: Phineas and Ferb
metas.description: Phineas and Ferb invent, scheme, and stay one step ahead of their bratty sister. Meanwhile, their pet platypus plots against evil Dr. Doofenshmirtz.

metas.name: Gravity Falls
metas.description: Twin siblings Dipper and Mabel Pines spend the summer at their great-uncle's tourist trap in the enigmatic Gravity Falls, Oregon.

metas.name: The Owl House
metas.description: Accidentally sent to the world of the Boiling Isles before a trip to summer camp, a teenage human named Luz longs to become a witch and is aided by rebellious Eda and pint-sized demon King.

metas.name: Amphibia
metas.description: Ordinary Anne Boonchuy, 13, finds a music box that sends her to Amphibia, a world full of frogs, toads, and giant insects. With help from Sprig, she must adjust to life in Amphibia and discover the first true friendship in her life.

metas.name: Kim Possible
metas.description: A high school cheerleader and her clumsy best friend balance their duties as global crime-fighters with the typical challenges of adolescence.

metas.name: DuckTales
metas.description: Triplets Huey, Dewey, and Louie accompany their wealthy uncle Scrooge McDuck on globe-trotting adventures and treasure hunts, while uncovering family secrets and facing dangerous enemies.

metas.name: DuckTales
metas.description: The comedy-adventure series chronicles the high-flying adventures of trillionaire Scrooge McDuck; his temperamental nephew Donald Duck; grandnephews Huey, Dewey, and Louie; Launchpad McQuack; and Mrs. Beakley and her granddaughter...

metas.name: Star vs. the Forces of Evil
metas.description: Star Butterfly arrives on Earth to live with the Diazes, a Mexican-American family. She continues to battle villains throughout the universe and high school, mainly to protect her extremely powerful wand, an object that still conf...

metas.name: Gargoyles
metas.description: A clan of heroic night creatures pledge to protect modern New York City as they did in Scotland one thousand years earlier.

metas.name: Recess
metas.description: Comic tales of a group of good friends, four boys and two girls, during breaks in primary school, as they grow up, relate to each other, and have brushes with authority.

metas.name: Darkwing Duck
metas.description: A bumbling superhero battles crime with the help of his daughter and pilot sidekick.

metas.name: TaleSpin
metas.description: Baloo the Bear from The Jungle Book (1967) is cast as a 1930s Pacific Islands bush pilot.

metas.name: Chip 'n' Dale Rescue Rangers
metas.description: Chip and Dale are chipmunks that start a detective agency, Rescue Rangers, with their friends. The gang deals with crimes that are 'too small' for the police to manage.

metas.name: Goof Troop
metas.description: The classic Disney character Goofy is a single father raising his son, Max, in Spoonerville. Pete, a frequent antagonist from the old cartoons, lives next door with his family.

metas.name: Big Hero 6: The Series
metas.description: Teen genius Hiro Hamada, Baymax the robot, and their friends defend the city of San Fransokyo as superheroes.

metas.name: Rapunzel's Tangled Adventure
metas.description: Unfolds as Rapunzel acquaints herself with her parents, her kingdom and the people of Corona.

metas.name: The Proud Family
metas.description: Follow the adventures and misadventures of Penny Proud as she does her best to navigate through the early years of teend-dom.

metas.name: American Dragon: Jake Long
metas.description: A teenage slacker is given the ability to turn into the American Dragon and defend all mythical creatures that secretly reside in the human world.

metas.name: Lilo & Stitch: The Series
metas.description: The rambunctious human and alien duo must hunt down Dr. Jumba Jookiba's 625 other experimental creatures infesting Hawaii.

metas.name: The Emperor's New School
metas.description: Continuation of 2000's The Emperor's New Groove, showcasing Kuzco's attempts to graduate from his kingdom's school, and his former advisor Yzma's evil attempts to keep him from his goal.

metas.name: Wander Over Yonder
metas.description: Wander is is eager to help anyone in the galaxy, together with his friend Sylvia. Wander's friendliness often angers Lord Hater, who is bent on galactic domination, and his army of Watchdogs.

metas.name: Star Wars Rebels
metas.description: Set between the events of Star Wars: Episodes III and IV, the story unfolds during a dark time when the evil Galactic Empire is tightening its grip of power on the galaxy. Imperial forces have occupied a remote planet and are ruining the lives of its people. The motley but clever crew of the starship Ghost — cowboy Jedi Kanan, ace pilot Hera, street-smart teenager Ezra, the “muscle” Zeb, warrior firebrand Sabine, and cantankerous old astromech droid Chopper — is among a select few who are brave enough to stand against the Empire. Together, they will face threatening new villains, encounter colorful adversaries, embark on thrilling adventures, and become heroes with the power to ignite a rebellion.

metas.name: Star Wars: The Clone Wars
metas.description: Jedi Knights lead the Grand Army of the Republic against the droid army of the Separatists.

metas.name: Big City Greens
metas.description: The adventurous life of Cricket Green, a country boy who moves with his family from their rural farm to a modern metropolis.

metas.name: Timon & Pumbaa
metas.description: The further misadventures of the lovable warthog Pumbaa and his meerkat buddy Timon from The Lion King (1994).

metas.name: Aladdin
metas.description: Aladdin, the clever hero of Agrabah, continues his adventures with the help of his fiancee Princess Jasmine, his pet monkey Abu, Magic Carpet, Iago the greedy parrot, and of course his best friend the semi-cosmic Genie.

metas.name: The Little Mermaid
metas.description: The 1989 animated feature adapted by Disney for television in a prequel that leads up to the events of the movie.

metas.name: Rockliffe's Folly
metas.description: Spin-off from Rockliffe's Babies which saw Ian Hogg's detective transferred from the Met to rural Dorset

metas.name: Herman Enciclopédia
metas.description: Herman encyclopedia is a sketch comedic show with every episode centered on a theme, The host (Herman) and other actors play many characters spoofing Portuguese TV shows, famous Portuguese people and other Portuguese related stuff.

metas.name: Buzz Lightyear of Star Command
metas.description: The further adventures of Buzz Lightyear as a Space Ranger of Star Command and his comrades.
